The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **"The Girl You Lost"**, priced at **£12.29**.

I went through both pages of the category, which hold 32 books in total. Five of them are rated five stars. The next cheapest is "The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2)" at £23.05. The tab I used is still open.

I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin's response page confirms it. I left that tab open at https://httpbin.org/post.

The server echoed back these form values:
- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and cheese (the form's value for Extra Cheese)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

Partway through, the shared browser connection had switched to another agent's tab (saucedemo.com). My first attempt to fill the form failed and changed nothing. I switched back to my own httpbin tab and did the work only there, without touching the other tab.

The order is complete. The confirmation page says "Thank you for your order!"

- I logged in as `standard_user` and sorted the products by price from low to high.
- I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light, and the cart showed just those two.
- I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The order total was $43.18.

The confirmation page (`https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html`) is still open in the tab I created.

My first browser command ran in another agent's tab (a Books to Scrape page) because the browser is shared. It failed before changing anything. After that I switched to my own saucedemo tab at the start of every command.
